scope: Follow-through on all 115 previously mapping-pending Arabic cards. The full saved card bodies are the supplied snapshot; five previously root-verified mappings were excluded. This is a source-term audit, not card approval. Relevant PDF sections were individually searched/read; selected pages were rendered for visual RTL/OCR verification. No Notion page was refetched.

source_catalog.access: Official Grade 5 portal lists the PE teacher guide; direct PDF downloaded/supplied locally. The PDF has 144 content pages; page labels match printed numbers in inspected sections. PDF pages 14–34, 35–46, 47–58, 59–74, 75–88, 89–115, 116–128 and 129–141 were rendered as contact sheets and searched in the text layer. Key term pages 17, 20–24, 30, 37–39, 49–52, 62–65, 69, 77–80, 91–103, 105–108, 119–120, 124, 132, 137, 139–140 were read; selected pages including 21–24, 50–52, 91–92, 100–101, 108, 119–120, 132 and 139 were visually inspected. source_catalog.sections: Teaching methods pp. 9–11; PE objectives pp. 12–13; fitness/health pp. 14–34 (strength p. 17, flexibility pp. 18–19, walking pp. 20–22, climbing/jumping pp. 23–24, running/walking activities pp. 30–32); football pp. 35–46 (inside-foot pass p. 37, inside-foot shot and sole control pp. 38–39); basketball pp. 47–58 (chest pass p. 49, stationary/moving dribble p. 50, lay-up pp. 51–52, stationary shooting named p. 52); volleyball pp. 59–74 (overhead pass p. 62, forearm pass p. 63, underhand serve pp. 64–65; no spike/block technique found); handball pp. 75–88 (reception pp. 77–78, whip pass pp. 79–81, group passing games pp. 86–87); athletics pp. 89–103 (running form pp. 91–92, long-jump measurement pp. 94/99, relay activity p. 97, hurdle/jump activities pp. 100–103); gymnastics pp. 104–115 (rolls pp. 105–107, balance beam p. 108); table tennis pp. 116–128 (forehand p. 119, backhand p. 120, racket ball-bouncing while walking p. 124); badminton pp. 129–141 (footwork p. 132, lesson aims p. 135, beanbag toss/catch p. 137, lateral movement games and movement cues pp. 139–140).
source_catalog.limits: A 2017 experimental Grade 5 teacher guide, not a current universal standard. Direct term matches support only the named skill or movement stated in the evidence; broader matches support only that movement family. Similarity does not validate a modified exercise/game. No age bands, equipment substitutions, custom rules, dimensions, times, repetitions, dosage, safety controls, adaptations or outcomes are certified. No medical treatment or dosage advice.
